name: Suzuki GS1100E
engine: 1074 cc air-cooled DOHC 16-valve inline four, four carbs
intro: Suzuki's big early-80s four. Fast and tough, with the usual GS charging and connector issues.

add.title: Run the Stator Papers checks
add.instructions: Test stator output and regulator voltage as the GS Resources Stator Papers describe. Clean and check every connector in the charging circuit, including the ignition switch.
add.reason: Burned connectors and a failing regulator take out stators on these bikes.

add.title: Replace the intake O-rings
add.instructions: Fit new OEM or Viton O-rings where the intake boots meet the head. Plain nitrile rings break down from the heat.
add.reason: Old O-rings leak air and make the bike run lean and hang its idle.

G: Clean carbs, set valves, no air leaks, a clean tank and a working petcock all have to be right before a GS runs right.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Charging system
known.what: Overcharging and burned connectors are the most common GS electrical fault. Clean every connector and run the Stator Papers checks.
